newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Banque Generale Lux in $1.0 bln euro cp.
newsitem.headline: Banque Generale Lux in $1.0 bln euro cp.

text.p: Luxembourg bank Banque Generale du Luxembourg said on Monday it signed a $1.0 billion euro commercial paper programme with a group of dealers.

Dealers are BZW Securities Ltd, Citibank International plc, Generale Bank, Goldman Sachs International, SBC Warburg, UBS ltd and BGL itself. UBS arranged the programme. Morgan Guaranty Trust Co is the issuing and paying agent.
The programme is rated A-1+ by Standard and Poor's and P-1 by Moody's.
BGL, a unit of Belgium's Generale Bank, said the issue marked its foray into the continously offered debt market and diversification away from customer deposits and the interbank market.
